query:
SELECT e.id, e.nomeDoEquipamento, e.codigoTag, e.setorId, s.nome as setorNome, e.grupoId, g.nome as grupoNome
FROM equipamentos e
LEFT JOIN setores s ON e.setorId = s.id
LEFT JOIN grupos_de_equipamentos g ON e.grupoId = g.id
WHERE e.id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.equipamentoSistemaId 
  FROM item_despesa_importado i
  WHERE i.periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 4 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1)
  AND i.equipamentoSistemaId IS NOT NULL
)
AND e.id NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT pd.equipamentoId 
  FROM parte_diaria pd 
  WHERE pd.data >= '2026-04-01' AND pd.data <= '2026-04-30'
  AND pd.equipamentoId IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY e.nomeDoEquipamento
LIMIT 20;
